resources.string: Keep recent game states in memory. Captures about once a second; may reduce performance.
Up to the selected duration, limited by a 64 MiB history budget. Cleared on exit, reset or loading a state.
Select Rewind (hold) under emulator functions. Tap to go back once; hold to continue.
Enable rewind in Settings → Buttons first.
No rewind history yet. Play for a moment first.
Rewind could not save or restore a state. Toggle rewind off and on to retry.
